newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GINOLA AIMS TO TAKE UP MOTOR RACING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GINOLA AIMS TO TAKE UP MOTOR RACING.

text.p: Newcastle winger David Ginola wants to take up motor racing and could quit the English premier league club at the end of the season.

The 29-year-old Frenchman, who features in a new television advertisement for Renault entitled Ginola Stays, said on Tuesday: "You should not read too much into the commercial's slogan because you never know what might happen at the end of the season.
"It is not easy to come to another country and work because you miss your family and friends and your normal way of life," he added.
Ginola has been talking to Renault about racing in next year's British Touring Car Championship and is to test drive a car next week with leading Swiss racer Alain Menu.
"I love motor racing and I want to do some pro driving but it depends on getting the go-ahead from Newcastle because of their insurance policy on me," he said.
